title: Concept: TLS error accepted via SslErrorHandler.proceed in kotlin — review required
description: In kotlin, the WebView SSL error handler calls proceed. The callback exists so the app can refuse a connection the platform rejected; proceeding instead accepts any certificate the attacker presents. Because the WebView keeps cookies and can expose JavaScript bridges, the impact reaches session theft, not just content spoofing.
applicability: kotlin Android apps that render remote content in a WebView.
risk: Traffic interception and content substitution; HIGH severity.
